caseNameFull: STOCK v. TERRENCE, STATE HOSPITAL DIRECTOR
attorneys: Walter J. Holloran for appellant., Louis J. Lefkowitz, Attorney General of New York, Paxton Blair, Solicitor General, and Joseph J. Rose, Assistant Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
